0x558372dc.reason: HDR gain map state word: one of the 44 bytes between the zero fill end and the heap (zero fill end 0x55839014 + 8, as 0x558372d4 + 8 in 1.11); no other GR Mod word there in 1.20 (0x55839020..0x5583903c are taken by the others), the firmware never addresses the gap

0x5450584c.reason: not an address: hdrgain.c packs the four output descriptor offsets 0x4c, 0x58, 0x50, 0x54 into one word; JpegEncodeMacroProcess::Execute is the same in 1.20 (0x53727e10, every instruction equal but address movw/movt), so the offsets are unchanged

0x531afbc0.reason: HDR gain map menu (0.8.9): visibility function of still-menu item 15 (0x0200007F), the one only the GR IV (not HDF, not Monochrome) shows; 1.20's still descriptor 0x53DC74B0 has item 15 = 0x0200007F with visibility 0x531B1130, which returns 1 / 0 / 0 for models 0 / 1 / 2 in the emulator as 0x531AFBC0 does in 1.11 (HDF's 0x531AFBE4 -> 0x531B1154 and Red Filter's 0x531AFC0C -> 0x531B117C sit right after it in both)
